description: This file contains a Swift extension on ChannelsSettings, defining the SwiftUI user interface components for a channels configuration view, including sidebars, details views, and associated UI logic.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs the sidebar view listing configured and available channels.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Constructs the detail view for the selected channel or an empty placeholder.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view prompting user to select a channel.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Builds detailed view of a specific channel, including header and section.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Creates a button row in the sidebar for each channel.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Creates a section header label in the sidebar.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Creates a header section for the channel detail view including status and actions.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Displays a status label with colored background.
